content: Human-labeling session — combat-protect-vip-escort:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a VIP escort mission across a long 144x40 lane, with seed-rotated staging. You are given 1 harvester (an unarmed ore-collector truck — your VIP, cannot fight back, starting at 70% HP) plus 4 medium tank escorts (Return-Fire orders), staged together at either the NORTH row (around y=16) or the SOUTH row (around y=24) depending on seed — read your actual starting row from the observation. The harvester is the ONLY one of its type on the map; if it dies, the mission is lost. The route holds two enemy heavy tanks at x=49 — one at (49,16), one at (49,24), each at 55% HP and on AttackAnything orders — backed by 3 riflemen at x=55 spanning y=16..24, plus a second rifle clump of 3 at x=85 spanning y=18..22, all AttackAnything. The heavies lunge at any of your units within ~16 cells of their posts. Bring the harvester to the extraction disc at (130,20) radius 6 within 5400 ticks.
